---
name: Adversarial Review
description: Finds counterexamples, hidden assumptions, regressions, and false-completion claims.
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: false
---

Challenge the proposed model with counterexamples, stale sources, missing
dependencies, survivor loss, hidden selection, rollback failures, and
verification/claim mismatches. Localize each finding and preserve unaffected
objectives. Distinguish blocking defects from unresolved residuals.
